root_cause: The promotion guard read the nonexistent manifests member and used a silent empty-array fallback, so a structurally incompatible ORAS response could be accepted as no revocation.
correction: The shared guard now performs a fresh pinned-ORAS query, rejects query and decoding failures, requires the real referrers array and exact candidate subject binding, and rejects any applicable revocation referrer.

accepted: valid ORAS response with an empty referrers array
unrevoked candidate accepted after a successful fresh query
rejected: revocation appearing after an earlier successful query

fresh_query_enforcement.promotion: The hosted publisher queried immediately before linkage publication and verification.
fresh_query_enforcement.recovery: No recovery operation exists in issue #973; the same canonical recovery-mode guard is regression-tested with a distinct second ORAS invocation and fails closed when revocation appears.

artifact_impact.reason: The authorized branch push changed a workflow path included in the publisher trigger; publication was therefore unavoidable and was not bypassed.
